Display Zoom listing copy vs layout engineering — two different jobs

US/EU indie teams conflate system display density with storefront language. iOS Settings and App Store Connect actually separate them:

  • Display Zoom on the device — on supported iPhone models, Settings → Display & Brightness → Display Zoom lets users pick Standard or Zoomed. Zoomed renders the interface at a lower logical resolution so controls, icons, and system text appear larger — 显示缩放, 标准, 缩放 under 显示与亮度. System display behavior — outside AppLocale scope.
  • Auto Layout and traitCollection engineering — code that adapts in-app UI to different screen sizes, safe areas, and display scales. Engineering inside the binary — not listing rewrite.
  • Display Zoom marketing on the product page — description paragraphs, subtitle positioning, keywords, promotional text, and screenshot overlays that tell buyers your app works well in Zoomed mode, respects Display Zoom UI density, or shows Standard vs Zoomed comparisons. Connect text fields — this page.
  • Pricing and Availability → China — makes the app downloadable on the China storefront. Separate from language rows.
  • App Store tab → Chinese (Simplified) localization — independent row for title, subtitle, keywords, description, promotional text, and screenshot caption lines. Empty or English here means China buyers see English fallback regardless of how strongly your US listing markets Display Zoom.

An app that layouts cleanly in Zoomed mode and a localized China listing are both valuable — neither replaces the other. AppLocale covers how you describe Standard vs Zoomed compatibility on the store page, not whether your binary adapts to display scale.

Display Zoom-specific listing vocabulary — what translates differently

UI-density marketing on App Store pages uses vocabulary general utility guides rarely cover. zh-Hans copy should reflect how Chinese buyers describe Display Zoom in iOS Settings — not a literal paste of US marketing:

Official Settings vocabulary

Apple's zh-Hans Settings UI uses 显示缩放 for Display Zoom under 显示与亮度 (Display & Brightness), with option labels 标准 (Standard) and 缩放 (Zoomed). Related buyer language includes 缩放显示 (zoomed display), 更大界面 (larger interface), and 界面元素更大 (larger UI elements). Listing copy should mirror that vocabulary — not generic 放大 that could mean Accessibility Zoom magnification.

Display Zoom vs Accessibility Zoom — do not conflate

Accessibility Zoom magnifies on-screen UI with a zoom window or full-screen zoom — 放大, 屏幕放大, 辅助功能放大 under Settings → Accessibility → Zoom. Display Zoom switches Standard vs Zoomed UI density under Display & Brightness — 显示缩放. If your English gallery shows an Accessibility Zoom controller, do not upgrade zh-Hans copy to 显示缩放 claims. See the Accessibility Zoom listing guide only if screen magnification is your lead marketing claim.

Display Zoom vs Larger Text — do not conflate

Larger Text enlarges typography via the accessibility text size slider — 更大字体, 字号可调. Display Zoom enlarges the entire interface layout including icons and spacing — 显示缩放. If your English gallery shows a Larger Text slider, do not upgrade zh-Hans copy to Display Zoom density claims. See the Larger Text listing guide only if the text size slider is your lead marketing claim.

Display Zoom vs Display Accommodations presets

Display Accommodations may reference accessibility display zoom presets under Accessibility settings — a different surface from Display & Brightness → Display Zoom. zh-Hans listing copy should not imply 颜色滤镜 or 显示调节 when your English source only shows the Standard vs Zoomed picker. See the Display Accommodations listing guide only if color filters or accessibility display presets are your lead marketing claim.

Display Zoom vs Dynamic Type developer claims

US pages sometimes say "Supports Dynamic Type" when screenshots show the Display Zoom picker or Zoomed UI comparisons. zh-Hans listing copy can use 支持显示缩放 or 缩放模式下界面更大 for buyer-facing Display Zoom marketing, and 支持动态字体 when your English source explicitly claims Dynamic Type API support. AppLocale aligns phrasing with your actual gallery and description scope — see the Dynamic Type listing guide when UIFontMetrics engineering is your lead story.

The 30-character subtitle and 100-character keyword field need Display Zoom and UI-density search terms Chinese buyers type — see Simplified Chinese keywords & subtitle for field mechanics. Terms like 显示缩放, 缩放显示, and 标准与缩放 each signal different intent from Larger Text terms like 更大字体 or Accessibility Zoom terms like 屏幕放大.

Marketing screenshot overlays you control — "Display Zoom" headlines on gallery frames showing Settings → Display & Brightness → Display Zoom — are separate caption fields or burned-in PNG text. Is Display Zoom the same as Accessibility Zoom?

No. Display Zoom switches Standard vs Zoomed UI density under Display & Brightness — 显示缩放. Accessibility Zoom magnifies on-screen UI with overlay controls under Settings → Accessibility → Zoom — 放大, 屏幕放大. See our Accessibility Zoom listing guide for screen magnification marketing copy.

Is Display Zoom the same as Larger Text or Text Size?

No. Display Zoom scales the entire interface layout — icons, spacing, and system chrome — 显示缩放. Larger Text enlarges typography via the accessibility text size slider — 更大字体. See our Larger Text listing guide for font-size slider marketing copy.

Related but different. Dynamic Type listing copy often covers UIFontMetrics support and scalable typography APIs.
